task_instance: Audit and fix the HTML metadata of a sample public product page (before.html) that had duplicate title and description tags, markdown/quote-spam in the description, a relative Open Graph image, an og:url that disagreed with the canonical, an erroneous noindex on a public page, invented JSON-LD ratings with invalid (trailing-comma) JSON, a missing html lang attribute and no favicon/Twitter card; produce a corrected after.html.
evidence: Created before.html (sample input) with deliberate metadata defects. Audited with a python3 -I stdlib script: 2 title tags, 2 meta description tags, og:url disagreeing with canonical, robots=noindex on a public page, html lang absent, relative og:image, and JSON-LD failing json.loads with 'Illegal trailing comma'. Applied the skill's priority rules to write after.html: single deterministic title and plain-text description, canonical and og:url made identical, robots set to index/follow, absolute og:image, full Open Graph + Twitter summary_large_image cards, html lang + og:locale, favicon and apple-touch-icon, and valid JSON-LD Product block with the invented aggregateRating removed. Re-ran the verification script against after.html: all 12 checks PASS (single title, single description, og:url==canonical, og:title==title, absolute og:image, plain-text description, indexable robots, html lang set, favicon present, twitter:card present, JSON-LD parses, no invented ratings). This is a pure guidance skill with no bundled scripts; the deliverable is the corrected metadata, which exists and was verified. Files: before.html, after.html in the work directory.
